payload.name: LNW Biblical Companion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
An AI reflective guide that applies Ryan Penny's Live Now Well (LNW) framework under the authority of Scripture, through a conservative evangelical lens.

It helps with Biblical and LNW learning, reflective personal application, trials, worry and perseverance, relationships, goals and habits, sanctification and capability development, Bible study, worship and prayer preparation, and handover summaries you control.

It is an AI. It does not have faith, pray, worship or receive revelation, it is not Ryan Penny, and it does not replace your church, pastor, counsellor or doctor. It offers spiritual and practical reflection grounded in Scripture. Before personal guidance it asks how you are (1 to 3) and how you would like it to respond (A, B or C).

Ryan's source material is read through your LIVE NOW WELL Biblically membership: connect once with your website login (email and password, or Google). Only short passages are used, and you can disconnect at any time in your account.
payload.longDescription:
一款AI反思指南，在圣经权威下应用瑞安·佩尼（Ryan Penny）的「活在当下」（LNW）框架，透过保守的福音派视角呈现。

涵盖圣经与LNW学习、反思性个人应用、试炼忧虑与忍耐、人际关系、目标习惯、成圣与能力发展、圣经研读、敬拜祷告准备，以及由您掌控的交接总结。

这是一款AI工具。
它不具有信仰、不祷告、不敬拜、不领受启示，它不是瑞安·佩尼，也不会取代您的教会、牧者、辅导或医生。
它提供基于圣经的属灵与实践反思。
在提供个人指导前，会先询问您的状态（1-3项）及希望它以何种方式回应（选项A/B/C）。

瑞安的原始资料需通过您的「活在当下」圣经会员权限访问：使用网站登录（邮箱密码或谷歌账号）完成一次连接即可。
仅使用短段经文，您可随时在账户中解除连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Live Now Well guidance, Read short passages of found guidance

payload.name: AstralRead
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AstralRead calculates astrology data precisely instead of guessing it. Give a birth date, place and (ideally) time, and it computes the natal chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: the sign, degree and house of every planet, the North Node and Chiron, the Ascendant and Midheaven, the twelve house cusps (Koch, Placidus or Whole Sign) and the major aspects with their exact orbs. For the Sun, Moon and Ascendant it adds a short note and a link to the matching page of the AstralRead knowledge base, written from classic astrology books.

It also lists the tight transits of any day to your chart (only aspects really within orb), shows the sky of a day — Moon sign and phase, lunations, sign changes, retrograde stations and exact aspects — and finds knowledge-base pages for a placement, aspect, house, pattern or transit.

Vedic (Jyotish) basics: the sidereal chart (Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses from the Lagna) with the rashi, house, nakshatra and pada of every graha, and the Vimshottari dasha periods with dates. Pure calculation in a kind tone: no dosha labels, no predictions.

In ChatGPT the chart is drawn as a wheel with planets, houses, aspect lines and today's transits; the Vedic chart as a South-Indian square chart with a dasha timeline.

Privacy: no account is needed and nothing is stored — birth data is used only for the calculation and is not logged. Astrology here is for self-reflection, not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. Works in English and Russian.
payload.longDescription:
AstralRead通过精确计算占星数据而非猜测来提供服务。输入出生日期、地点和（理想情况下）时间，它将使用瑞士星历表（Swiss Ephemeris）生成本命盘：每颗行星的星座、度数和宫位、北交点与凯龙星、上升点与中天、十二宫宫头（采用柯克、普拉西德或全星座系统）以及主要相位及其精确相位范围。对于太阳、月亮和上升点，还会附加简要说明和链接至AstralRead知识库的对应页面，该页面内容源自经典占星术书籍。

它还会列出任意日期与您本命盘的紧密相位（仅显示真正处于相位范围内的相位），展示某一天的天象——包括月相与月相变化、黄道星座转换、逆行转折点及精确相位，并能为特定星体位置、相位、宫位、星象格局或行运找到对应的知识库页面。

吠陀占星（Jyotish）基础功能：黄道坐标系盘（采用Lahiri岁差值，以命宫为基准的全星座宫位），显示每个行星的黄道十二宫（Rashi）、宫位、纳沙特拉（Nakshatra）及帕达（Pada），以及维姆绍特里（Vimshottari）命主周期及其日期。纯数学计算，语气中立：不标注体液（Dosha）类型，不提供预测。

在ChatGPT中，占星盘以行星、宫位、相位线和今日行运的轮盘图呈现；吠陀占星盘则以南印度方形图形式展示，并附命主周期时间轴。

隐私政策：无需账户且不存储任何数据——出生信息仅用于计算且不会被记录。此处的占星术仅用于自我反思，不构成医疗、心理、法律或财务建议。支持英语和俄语。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Natal chart calculation, Daily transits to your chart, Sky of the day, Astrology knowledge base lookup, Chart wheel view, Vedic chart & nakshatras, Vimshottari dasha periods

payload.name: The Archivist
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask questions about the published AGE OF AIMPIRES archive and open source pages with canonical links. The Archivist covers the publication's entries, frameworks and guides about practical AI use. It reports when the archive does not support an answer. Exact quotations should be checked against the current published page. Archive search uses a fixed indexed snapshot; page reading retrieves the current publication. This initial pilot has a shared allowance of 25 archive provider attempts per UTC day and 250 per UTC month, including retries. Reading published pages does not use that allowance.
payload.longDescription:
针对已发布的AGE OF AIMPIRES档案和开源页面的规范链接提出问题。
档案馆收录了该出版物关于实用人工智能的条目、框架和指南。

档案搜索使用固定索引快照；页面阅读则获取最新发布内容。
此初期试点版本每日共享25次档案调用额度和每月250次调用额度（包含重试次数）。
阅读已发布页面不占用该额度。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search The Published Archive, Read Published Pages

Deleted books and removed words stay in WordAI's trash for 7 days and can be restored. It can also prepare a private draft list for you to review first. Search history is off by default. Sign-in and approval happen on WordAI's own page; you can disconnect anytime in the WordAI app. Requires a WordAI account.

询问任何英文单词或短语：WordAI会解释该词，并直接链接到该单词、您的单词书或WordAI应用中的闪卡复习。
在获得您的授权后，它会读取您的WordAI单词书和学习进度，以个性化学习列表和复习内容，并在您明确要求时保存单词、创建、编辑和删除单词书。
已删除的书籍和移除的单词将在WordAI的垃圾箱中保留7天，可恢复。
它还可以为您准备一份私人草稿列表供先期复习。

Review your due spaced-repetition flashcards and see your weakest systems and topics so ChatGPT can help you plan your studying. Answers and flashcard reviews sync to your StepGenie account.

The question of the day works without an account. Connect your StepGenie account to practice from the QBank, review flashcards and see your weak areas.

您可以在聊天窗口直接练习StepGenie题库中的NBME风格USMLE Step 1、Step 2 CK和Step 3试题。
通过互动式卡片作答后，可获取StepGenie提供的分步视觉解析，包含其他选项错误的原因说明。

payload.name: Paperguide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Paperguide is an AI-native platform for scientific research and evidence synthesis. Search over 200 million academic papers, explore scientific literature, read full text from your saved research PDFs, and organize references in your Paperguide workspace.

Discover research. Search papers and preprints from PubMed, arXiv, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar. Find relevant studies using natural language, refine results by publication year, citations, open-access availability, or PDF availability, and retrieve paper details by DOI or PubMed ID. Explore scientific findings, compare studies, and plan literature reviews with links to the sources.

Read and organize papers. Save research papers by DOI or PDF link, retrieve available full text from saved references, and ask questions about their methods, results, and conclusions. Search within attached PDFs, create or rename folders, and organize your references across research projects.

Support systematic reviews. Access your existing reviews, identify papers missing PDFs, attach available full-text documents, and track PDF processing to support screening and evidence extraction within Paperguide.

Built for students, PhD researchers, academics, clinicians, and research teams conducting literature searches, evidence synthesis, and systematic reviews. A Paperguide account is required. Some research and full-text operations use Paperguide AI credits; full-text access depends on document availability and account permissions. Review screening and extraction take place in Paperguide.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Scientific literature search, Research paper discovery, Read and search saved PDFs, Reference management, Systematic review PDF management

payload.name: Paceword Speed Reader
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Learn to read faster with paced speed reading practice inside the chat. Paceword Speed Reader shows supplied text using RSVP: words flash at a selected pace with a fixed focus letter to support visual tracking. Playback includes pause, ten-word jumps, speed controls, restart, clickable progress, and time left. Estimate how long a document will take to read from its text or a word count. The result includes a 150–800 words-per-minute table plus speaking-time estimates at 130 and 150 words per minute. For practice, choose a short, medium, or long original passage and answer four multiple-choice comprehension questions after timing your own reading. This is a training aid. Comprehension can decrease at high speed. It is not a medical or learning-disability assessment. Chinese text is split by character rather than by linguistic word.
payload.longDescription:
在聊天中通过节奏阅读练习提升阅读速度。
Paceword Speed Reader采用RSVP技术展示文本：单词以选定速度逐个闪现，并包含固定焦点字母以辅助视觉追踪。
播放功能包含暂停、逐10词跳跃、速度控制、重新开始、可点击进度条以及剩余时间显示。
可通过文本内容或字数统计预估文档阅读时长。
结果包含150-800词/分钟的阅读速度对照表，以及130和150词/分钟的口语化朗读时间估算。
练习时可选择短、中、长三种原文段落，在自行计时后回答4道多选理解题。
本工具仅作为训练辅助工具。
高速阅读可能导致理解度下降。
本工具不提供医疗或学习障碍评估。
中文文本按字符分割而非语言词汇。

payload.name: NaCl Prep
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Practise the vocabulary that comes up in the NAATI CCL exam, right inside ChatGPT.

NaCl Prep has 5000+ CCL words across health, legal, immigration, education, social services, housing, business, consumer affairs, financial, community and insurance topics, translated into 40 languages including Hindi, Punjabi, Mandarin, Nepali, Vietnamese, Arabic, Tamil and Urdu.

- Pick a topic and practise with flashcards or a multiple-choice quiz, English to your language, your language to English, or both ways, just like the real test.
- Listen to each word in English and your language.
- Words you miss are saved for review, and new sets skip words you already know. Progress is kept on your device.
- Turn the words you missed into a CCL role-play: ChatGPT runs a short dialogue one segment at a time and gives feedback on your interpreting.
- Ask ChatGPT about the word on screen, or look up how a term is translated in the NaCl Prep list.
- Open it from the sidebar or beside any chat.

Each set has up to 10 words. The full list, mock tests and AI scoring are on naclprep.com.

For people preparing for the NAATI Credentialed Community Language test. Not affiliated with NAATI.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT内部直接练习NAATI CCL考试中出现的词汇。

NaCl Prep涵盖健康、法律、移民、教育、社会服务、住房、商业、消费者事务、金融、社区和保险等主题的5000+个CCL词汇，支持包括印地语、旁遮普语、普通话、尼泊尔语、越南语、阿拉伯语、泰米尔语和乌尔都语在内的40种语言翻译。

- 选择一个主题通过闪卡或多选测验练习，支持英语到你的语言、你的语言到英语，或双向练习，如同真实考试
- 听取每个单词的英语和你的语言发音
- 错误单词会保存用于复习，新练习集会跳过你已掌握的词汇
- 进度保存在您的设备上
- 将错词转化为CCL情景对话：ChatGPT分段运行简短对话并提供口译反馈
- 可向ChatGPT询问屏幕上的单词，或在NaCl Prep列表中查找术语翻译
- 从侧边栏或任意聊天界面打开

每组包含最多10个单词
完整词汇表、模拟测试和AI评分请访问naclprep.com

适用于准备NAATI认证社区语言考试的人士

It is a creative-thinking partner, not a seven-box worksheet generator. Its remote tool is read-only; it does not store Remix Briefs, access student records, or process payments.

payload.name: Inductive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Inductive's absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity (ADMET) models predict the chemical and pharmacokinetic properties that determine whether a molecule can become a viable drug. By surfacing these predictions directly in your conversation, scientists can evaluate compounds, triage ideas, and prioritize which molecules to synthesize, without leaving their existing workflow.

Through this MCP server, users can access Inductive’s models for the physicochemical properties LogD (lipophilicity) and pKa (acid/base ionization), key drivers of solubility and permeability.
payload.longDescription:
Inductive 的吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性（ADMET）模型可预测决定分子能否成为可行药物的化学和药代动力学性质。科学家无需离开现有工作流，即可在对话中查看这些预测、评估化合物、筛选想法，并确定优先合成哪些分子。

通过此 MCP 服务器，用户可使用 Inductive 模型预测 LogD（亲脂性）和 pKa（酸碱电离）等物理化学性质；这些性质是溶解性和渗透性的关键影响因素。

payload.name: Genomic Intelligence
payload.description: 使用 AI 分析 DNA 序列
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Run six DNA sequence-analysis tasks over the hosted Genomic Intelligence API: promoter region prediction, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression, and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Give it a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a FASTA; it resolves the sequence from Ensembl and returns structured predictions. No local GPU, model weights, or API key required. For research use, not clinical or diagnostic decisions.
payload.longDescription: 通过托管的 Genomic Intelligence API 执行六类 DNA 序列分析任务：启动子区域预测、剪接供体/受体位点、增强子活性、染色质状态、序列到表达的预测，以及从头基因注释；还可执行“查找基因后预测表达”的组合工作流。输入基因符号、基因组区域或 FASTA 序列，应用会从 Ensembl 解析序列并返回结构化预测。无需本地 GPU、模型权重或 API 密钥。仅供研究使用，不用于临床或诊断决策。

payload.name: Pendar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.
payload.longDescription:
Pendar 为您展示研究领域的全貌，而不只是摘要。

输入一个主题，它会报告相关论文数量、研究产出是在增长还是趋于平缓、哪些学科和国家在产出论文，以及应优先阅读哪些论文。每项数据都基于整个语料库统计，而非根据样本估算，帮助您据此进行规划。

输入一篇论文，它会追踪后续发展：引用是在增加还是减少、哪些领域采用了这项研究、业界或学界是否在此基础上继续研究，以及引用该论文最多的作者。这有助于判断一篇论文是在悄然成为奠基性研究，还是早在数年前就已达到热度高峰。

粘贴参考文献目录后，它会逐条对照已发表记录进行核查：论文是否存在、引文描述是否准确，以及论文是否已撤稿。找不到的参考文献会标记为“未验证”，而不会替换成最接近的真实论文；当引文来自模型时，这一点尤为重要。

所有工具均为只读。Pendar 只会查找并报告结果。

payload.name: PeptidePrices COA Verifier
payload.description: 核验肽类 COA 证据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and inspect public peptide certificates of analysis using the PeptidePrices evidence library and supported laboratory records. Look up exact report identifiers or public certificate URLs, review vendor and compound matches, inspect reported testing panels, browse a vendor’s published certificate feed, or compare documented COA coverage across vendors. Results keep laboratory-record confirmation, vendor attribution, product and labeled-strength matching, reported analytical results, and physical-vial chain of custody separate. Missing, blocked, unsupported, or unresolved records remain unknown rather than being treated as failures. Each result includes structured evidence and links to PeptidePrices, certificate documents, and specific official laboratory records when available.
payload.longDescription: 利用 PeptidePrices 证据库及受支持的实验室记录，搜索和检查公开的肽类分析证书（COA）。查找精确的报告编号或公开证书 URL，查看供应商和化合物的匹配情况，检查报告中的检测项目，浏览供应商发布的证书列表，或比较不同供应商有记录支持的 COA 覆盖情况。结果会分别呈现实验室记录确认、供应商归属、产品及标签标示含量或浓度的匹配、报告中的分析结果，以及实体样品瓶的保管交接链。缺失、访问受阻、不受支持或尚未解决的记录仍标为未知，不会被视为核验失败。每项结果都包含结构化证据，以及指向 PeptidePrices、证书文件和具体官方实验室记录（如有）的链接。

payload.name: Peptide Critic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Peptide Critic provides independent vendor reviews, third-party lab testing and price comparison for research peptides such as BPC-157, GHK-Cu and TB-500. Find compounds by name or synonym, compare vendor ratings and review counts, inspect vendor-level lab-verified COA and warning flags, compare list and discounted prices per milligram, and find coupon codes. Filter comparisons by vendors' shipping origin and pack size, or look up a vendor profile. Results use Peptide Critic's Best Value ranking, which favors partners when offers are comparable; returned buy links are tracked affiliate links. The app returns public catalogue data without sign-in and does not place orders or process payments. Prescription-drug analogues are excluded from compound search and comparison. Research use only; no dosing or medical advice.
payload.longDescription: Peptide Critic 为 BPC-157、GHK-Cu 和 TB-500 等研究肽提供独立供应商评价、第三方实验室检测和价格比较。按名称或同义词查找化合物，比较供应商评分和评价数量，查看供应商级别的实验室验证 COA 及警示标志，比较每毫克的标价和折扣价，并查找优惠码。可按供应商发货地和包装规格筛选，或查看供应商档案。结果采用 Peptide Critic 的最佳价值排名，在报价相当时倾向合作伙伴；返回的购买链接为跟踪型联盟链接。应用无需登录即可返回公开目录数据，不下单也不处理付款。处方药类似物不纳入化合物搜索和比较。仅供研究使用；不提供剂量或医疗建议。
